subject: {first_name}, I built this after one too many "trust the tipster" takes
preview_text: Every result published. Verify us race by race.
body_paragraphs: Every race day, the same scene: confident tips flying around — "this horse is due," "the jockey always delivers here," "I just feel it." Nobody checking form, going, draw, or what the numbers actually say.

I built Predictify Horse Racing because racing arguments shouldn't be won by whoever shouts loudest. We wanted forecasts you can pressure-test: form, jockey, track, going, and a calibrated confidence score on win, place, and each-way picks.

A friend of ours learned this the hard way at a festival meeting. The model flagged a favorite at 59% confidence — closer to a coin flip than a lock. He ignored it, followed the tipster, and lost. Two weeks later he opened a pick in our highest-confidence band (80%+ tier), read the breakdown, and called it before post time. Same friend. Different process.
That's why we publish every result — wins and losses — so you can verify the track record yourself, race by race.
Your next step takes about 30 seconds: open today's card, pick one race, and read the reasoning before the off.
P.S. We're not a bookmaker. No guaranteed wins — just transparent forecasts and a record you can check.
